scope: Read-only investigation of extracted Dice of Kalma ARM64 IL2CPP. Ordinary scoring flow; challenge branches are not fully reconstructed.

native_facts.finding: Mercy (trigger 54) activates after spending the last reroll while one hand remains. It is not deferred until PlayHand.

Initial/reroll bones and multiplier contributions accumulate into saved currentBones/currentMult and survive ordinary rerolls. Scoring begins from those values, then adds dice sum, category, upgrades and play-phase modifiers.
PlayHand starts a coroutine which disables input before its first yield. The caller then spends one hand. Later play-phase predicates see that post-cost hand count.

Modifier eligibility is scanned in ascending owned-inventory-slot order. All effects are accumulated synchronously; earlier grants do not change later predicates. Actual activations use owned-slot identity for the per-hand activation gate.

The modifier animation cycles activated skulls one by one, while score counters animate aggregate before/after totals concurrently. Native presentation is not a sequence of per-modifier arithmetic increments.
evidence: Each RollTexts is StartCoroutine without intervening yield

native_facts.finding: Native base animationTime is 0.5 seconds, and soundIntervalTime is 0.04 seconds. Dice/category use longAnimTime = 1 second. For N activated play modifiers, the aggregate animation lasts 0.5*(N+1) seconds; each icon receives that duration divided by N.

Normal scoring highlights/counts the dice sum, then category/upgrades, then modifiers, then the multiplied total. Bone and multiplier box hit markers bracket their count animations. The total is calculated only after modifier totals are available.
The next hand is rolled later in the points coroutine, after scoring presentation, rather than immediately replacing the displayed dice when PlayHand is pressed.

engine_mapping_and_recommendations: Current EncounterSession.Play completes its mechanical transaction synchronously and can call StartHand before returning. Preserve a pre-command presentation snapshot of the played dice, contributions and resources; reveal post-command next-hand state only after playback.
Use recorded contribution/event data for presentation. Never rerun eligibility while counter animations advance.
Previously activated initial/reroll contributions belong in starting displayed accumulators and must not be replayed or added again at PlayHand.
Explicit per-modifier numerical increments would be a deliberate presentation change from this native build, although they preserve arithmetic if driven from the same recorded contributions.

Native per-modifier dice highlights are derived from a parallel list built by CheckSkullEffects. The current ModifierContribution carries no affected-dice list; highlighting all played dice is a presentation choice unless the trigger's actual matching dice are reconstructed separately.
limits: No live reference-device playback was performed in this investigation.
SoundManager calls were found in RollTexts, including Click1, Click4, Click5, CoinJingle0, CoinJingle2, Ding1 and Swoosh. Exact sound-to-counter branch mapping is not fully reconstructed here.
The claim that dice remain frozen is based on the input gate and delayed next-roll control flow, not a dedicated immutable native played-dice object.

Disassembler's inline register-derived annotations can be stale across branches. Conclusions use instructions, field offsets, named calls and explicit literal bytes, not incidental inferred addresses.
